scope: Same-host TCP. All native cells run five times; every sample retained. Diagnostic captures use separate short budgets and never enter timing results.
goal: portable mean and pooled p50 < fixed C++ independently, and positive reads/writes plus attempts <= C++ independently per process capture.
statistics: mean_ns is the pooled arithmetic mean; displayed ± run SD is sample SD (n-1) across five run means, not a confidence interval. Sample SD and extrema are retained separately.

compression.scope: Lossless compression of unsealed first-iteration profiles and retained test executables; restore original paths in a fresh workspace before rerunning scripts. Earlier sealed evidence was not modified.

branch_simulation.scope: Whole-process Callgrind simulation, including startup/warmup/teardown; not hardware counters or native timings.

first_iteration.scope: Separate five-run campaign, not a paired latency comparison with the selected version.
first_iteration.reason_superseded: Requeued ready internal stages; eager protocol invalidation did O(capacity) work outside the shared budget.
